evidence_class: local fixture runs and CI on the pull request head; mocked, no live infrastructure read or mutated

states.observed: the validator names the screenshot-only package in each fixture (transcript durability and scope isolation) and no finding for the fully evidenced packages
states.accepted: record, restore and reopen apply only under the registry lock at the expected revision; replays have no second effect; refused requests leave the registry bytes unchanged
states.committed: registry, rendered index, validator, fixtures and case results at the tested commit
states.externally_verified: CI Tests run 37695042602 on the tested commit: lint, eight unit shards, sonar, mutation (validate_plan 1258 killed, runner 57 killed, 0 survived) and Gate passed

interfaces: docs/swarm-v2/evidence-index.json (schema swarm-v2-evidence-index/1: invariant requirements with class and package ids, package claims and append-only evidence, operation log)
docs/swarm-v2/evidence-index.md (rendered projection: gates, invariants, claimed packages, findings, failed experiments, packages_missing_evidence)
scripts.swarm_v2.validate_plan: load_plan, gates, load_index, validate, check, record, restore, reopen, render, main (check, render, record, restore, reopen)
scripts.ci_mutation.runner.prepare_workspace copies evidence/ and Swarm-v2.md into the mutation workspace, skipping the workspace itself
tests/fixtures/swarm_v2/evidence (packages.json and packages-second.json: fully evidenced packages plus a screenshot-only claim each)
evidence/SV2-FND-04/generate_case_results.py (case results from junit by section marker)

supported_versions.plan: Swarm-v2.md package headings with Repository, Dependencies, Integration gate and Positive, Negative and Recovery case lines
supported_versions.proof_kinds: test and live_canary results are GitHub Actions run or job URLs or UTF-8 .json, .log, .txt or .xml repository files pinned by sha256; screenshots and failed experiments are recorded but satisfy nothing

authority: delegated to repository write access and pull request review, the same authority as the FND-02 architecture record; the validator takes no actor input, so no display label can grant anything and the B case has no grant to broaden
rollback_rehearsal: reopen of SV2-FND-03 on a copy of the committed registry at the tested commit: the claim projection returns to open, every evidence item is byte equal, and check still reports zero findings
rollback_command: python -m scripts.swarm_v2.validate_plan reopen --package <id> --operation <id> reverts a claim projection without touching evidence; reverting the pull request removes only the registry, validator, fixtures and case results, no stored state elsewhere
limitations: A restore over an unreadable registry cannot know the lost high-water revision; the result reports replaced: unreadable and the git history of the committed registry holds the revision.

The registry stores claims and the validator judges them, so record accepts a complete claim that check then flags; the committed registry test pins zero findings, which keeps such a claim out of dev.
SV2-FND-04 itself is not yet claimed in the registry; recording it needs a later change, because the registry tests treat the committed document as their base.
Invariant to package mapping is authored in the registry; the plan does not map invariants to packages itself.
The registry lock is a host-local flock; concurrent writers on different hosts are serialized by git and pull request review.
